article.story: STONY BROOK, N.Y. -- — Bryan Ndjonga’s 18 points helped Stony Brook open the season with a 97-47 victory over SUNY-Old Westbury on Monday. Ndjonga added seven rebounds for the Seawolves. Leonardo Van Elswyk scored 17 points, going 8 for 9 from the field. Morris Ugusuk shot 3 for 5 from the field and 5 for 5 from the line to finish with 11 points. Siddiq McMair led the Panthers with 14 points. SUNY-Old Westbury also got 12 points from Imole Akinwale. Mircea-Nicole Simu added seven points. Up next Stony Brook plays at Northwestern on Friday, and SUNY-Old Westbury visits Columbia on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
